write_up: This is a strong payments resume! At Tidewater Commerce, you connect the services you built and the work you led to performance, reliability and audit results. A recruiter can see both your hands-on backend work and how you lead other engineers.

The ledger line is a particularly good model: it names the service and shows how reconciliation breaks changed. The earlier billing work reinforces the same story with an invoicing API and a faster generation process.

Your resume itself is unlikely to be the thing holding you back. The fit and competitiveness of the jobs you pursue will still matter. Before sending it, add what the Northwind dashboards let the billing team monitor.
